blockers: No licensed, consented, physically measured real-produce dataset is present.
No QA-approved segmentation masks with inter-annotator review are present.
No ARL/Growize-approved crop thresholds exist, so a learned grader could not be validated against a real decision policy.
No compatible GPU is available in this environment; CPU-only Torch cannot support a credible training/evaluation run within the handoff window.
Training without a leakage-safe, grouped real split would produce numbers that must not be reported.
what_exists_instead: Deterministic OpenCV baseline shipped as the release path.
Synthetic fixtures verify geometry and refusal contracts only.
Manifest validator and grouped splitter are ready for real data.
A model card records the absent model rather than inventing one.
exit_meaning: No weights, metrics, checkpoints, or training logs were produced.
